content:
jamie: Quick sync — planning version bumps across API, runtime, console, SDKs. Want to avoid a single-day squeeze. Proposed stagger: API -> runtime -> SDKs -> console, over 48h window. Thoughts?

olivia: Sounds good. Is the goal to keep SDK semver aligned with API?
vijay: yes, SDKs should follow API patch/major as needed. We can cut SDK rc after API is cut and validated.
sara: Callout: runtime team needs extra time for the quantized kernel bump. They asked for a 24h buffer after API.
jamie: OK noted. Proposed timeline (UTC):
- Tue 10:00 API bump to v0.22.0, branch release/0.22
- Tue 16:00 runtime bump to v0.10.0, branch release/0.10
- Wed 08:00 SDKs bump to v0.22.0 (follow API), publish rc -> prod after smoke tests
- Wed 18:00 Console bump to 1.4.0 (UI changelog + migration notes)

olivia: Nice. Can we add changelog owners: API -> @olivia, runtime -> @vijay, SDKs -> @sara, console -> @jamie?
vijay: I can handle runtime changelog. Will coordinate with infra for any kernel rollout flags.
sara: SDK changelog will need example snippets for new client retry behavior. I'll draft tonight.

release-bot: [automated] Created release branches: release/0.22 (api), release/0.10 (runtime), release/0.22-sdk, release/1.4-console. PR templates prefilled.
jamie: Thanks bot. Two operational items:
1) Cutoff for tests/feature-freeze is Tue 08:00 UTC — no new feature PRs into release branches after that.
2) If any compatibility risk spotted, we fallback runtime -> compatible-quantized-0.9 variant (auto-route).

olivia: Re: build matrix — API has a breaking change flag in #api-breaks. I'm adding a small migration note in the changelog now.
vijay: Runtime team requests that we delay canary if perf regression >5% on p99. We'll add a perf-check CI gate (script: `scripts/perf-check --baseline=prod`).
sara: SDK publish steps: merge release branch -> tag -> `npm publish` + `pip wheel` job. I'll put a checklist in the SDK PR body.

jamie: Can folks review the release PRs by Tue 09:30 UTC so we can catch blockers before the 10:00 cut? Tagging reviewers in PRs now.

olivia: pinged @frontend-eng for console migration notes review. Also adding a shout to support for docs updates.
vijay: I'll run a quick smoke on staging runtime after bump and post results here.

release-bot: [automated] CI: all release branch checks queued. Expected merge window -> Tue 10:00-12:00 UTC.
jamie: Great. If anything slips, mark it with `release-delay` label and we regroup async here. Otherwise we proceed with the staggered plan. :thumbsup:

sara: Got it — will post SDK checklist and PR link when ready.

vijay: Perf smoke: staging p99 increased 2.1% after local kernel bump — under threshold. Proceeding to canary.
jamie: Excellent. Thanks team. I'll post a final reminder Tue 07:30 UTC and again 09:45 UTC.

olivia: One last thing — please add short migration note for consumers of the streaming API (changed chunking behavior). I'll draft and attach to API PR.
jamie: Perfect. Closing loop here unless any objections. If none, we'll follow plan and watch the canaries. :rocket:
